developmentStatus: Offline cross-fitted policy development on the already analyzed frozen 50-case answer panel. Passing can only justify implementation and untouched-data confirmation; it cannot promote a new incumbent or support a fresh confirmatory claim.

allowed.definition: Number of obsolete spans replaced across the query-selected V1 candidate set.
Number of query-selected V1 candidates whose rendering changed.
redactionCount divided by max(1, selected V1 candidate count).
(V1 injected tokens - shield injected tokens) divided by max(1, V1 injected tokens). Both renderings are computed before routing.

policyClass.capacityLimit: Exactly the 32 predeclared stumps; no post-score thresholds, conjunctions, trees, or task-specific exceptions.

crossFitting.selectionData: All personas except the held-out persona.
crossFitting.whenNoStumpIsEligible: Use always-v1 for that held-out fold.

aggregation.primary: Cross-model mean: each reader answer is scored only by the other model.
aggregation.counterfactualAssumption: Each routed outcome is copied from the already observed answer cell for the selected action; no model response is synthesized or imputed.

fallback.runtime: Malformed policy, missing or non-finite feature, timeout, or exception returns the unchanged V1 candidate rendering for the whole call.
fallback.offlineEvaluation: Missing paired outcomes, duplicated cells, input hash mismatch, or persona leakage fails the run rather than imputing an outcome.
